hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; markdownlint "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.json) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; jsonlint "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) shfmt -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; shellcheck "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.yaml|*.yml) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; yamllint "$f";; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.el) out=$(emacsclient --eval "(with-temp-buffer (insert-file-contents \"$f\") (emacs-lisp-mode) (check-parens))" 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ "$ec" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out"; fi; exit "$ec";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.lua) stylua "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && luacheck "$(basename "$f")");; esac; }

environment: **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Source control**: None configured — no orgs beyond each session's own working repo and remote

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Primary use of Claude Code**: personal, non-enterprise software projects (e.g. Linux desktop config, personal tooling, notes) — hobby/personal use, not work
